title: Microsoft Purview DLP: block Copilot web search when prompts contain sensitive data (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the briefing treats prompt-protection entitlement as unpublished, although Microsoft's Purview service description includes DLP to safeguard prompts for all Copilot and Copilot Chat users. It also incorrectly guarantees that prompts outside the selected sensitive information types reach web search, regardless of other web-search controls. The roadmap facts, documented policy route and PowerShell call are supported.

The printed Microsoft Purview portal route reaches the Performing Web Searches rule action through the Custom policy and Copilot location.
claims.quote: Go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy. Select the Custom template, then Custom policy. On the Locations page, set the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location to on.

claims.claim: New-DlpComplianceRule accepts the printed Name, Policy and SIT hashtable parameters, with RestrictWebGrounding $true setting the web-grounding block.
claims.quote: The RestrictWebGrounding parameter specifies an action for the DLP rule that blocks web grounding. Valid values are: $true: Web grounding is blocked. $False: Web grounding isn't blocked. This value is the default.
